parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the ENS node.

parameters.name: EnsRegionIds
parameters.description: The IDs of edge nodes. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs.

parameters.name: NetworkId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC to which the vSwitch belongs.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: VSwitchIds
parameters.description: The IDs of vSwitches. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-vswitches --ens-region-id cn-xian-unicom --vswitch-id vsw-5m9xhlq8oh000 --vswitch-name testVSwitchName --network-id vpc-25cdvfeq58pl0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --ens-region-ids cn-chengdu-telecom-4 --vswitchids vsw-50000tzrpf --enable-ipv6 true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens DescribeVSwitches --region cn-hangzhou --EnsRegionIds.1 'cn-chengdu-telecom-4' --PageSize 10 --VSwitchIds.1 'vsw-50000tzrpf' --PageNumber 1 --VSwitchId 'vsw-5m9xhlq8oh000' --VSwitchName testVSwitchName --EnsRegionId 'cn-xian-unicom' --NetworkId 'vpc-25cdvfeq58pl0000' --EnableIpv6 true --method POST --force
